reason: Conversation 1 ends with an incoherent diagnosis of 'blocked pump filter' after the customer had cleaned the filter and inspected the impeller, never clarifies what FD 9409 is, and never asks for the E-Nr or addresses the part question at all. Conversation 2 correctly refuses to name a part from the FD code, explains the E-Nr is required, declines to guess a part number, keeps the customer unplugged, and escalates sensibly when he won't open the cabinet. Conversation 2 is overconfident in calling the pump 'almost certainly failed' (a sump-hose blockage remains possible) and its 'top cover' label advice is shaky, but it is far more honest and useful than Conversation 1's contradictory conclusion.
